text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Power is welling up... and not just that. 
It's as if my thoughts are being 
sharpened—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Could it be the statue of the Three 
Goddesses gave me power? Is it telling me 
to seize glory with this strength...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—If that's the case, I'll gladly accept. 
Yes, we have a deal!
